summary: Verified all 4 requested changes on JARVIS mobile app. BACKEND (6/6 pytest passing in 53.7s): POST /api/search/delete-many bulk-deletes searches + cascades results (deleted_count=2 of 3 verified via GET /api/search/active); POST /api/results/delete-many bulk-deletes results (2 of 4 verified via GET /api/search/{id}/results); DELETE /api/results/{id} works and returns 404 on repeat; empty ids array on both bulk endpoints returns 400; single DELETE /api/search/{id} still works (non-regression) and POST /api/search/process still returns AI-generated results. FRONTEND (Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844): (1) Home has NO 'Crea Ricerca' button anymore, all 8 category buttons present, tapping category-button-immobili navigates directly to /category/immobili showing search-input. (2) Result cards contain title, description, prominent 'Fonte:' box with blue left border showing domain (immobiliare.it, casa.it) and full URL below, Contatti section, and 'Vai al sito' button — visually verified via screenshot. NO 'Parole Chiave'/'KEYWORDS' section anywhere on the results page. (3) Multi-select on results: long-press (500ms mouse down) triggers selection mode, result-checkbox appears, header shows 'N selezionati', tapping second card selects it, red bottom bar shows 'Elimina 2 annunci', select-all-button and cancel-selection-button work, cancel exits mode cleanly. (4) Source link section is clearly visible with clean domain extraction (getSourceLabel strips 'www.') and full URL underneath. (5) History multi-select: /history shows 5 items, long-press activates selection mode with history-checkbox-{id} and delete-selected-button appearing. Backend URL used: https://jarvis-assistant-603.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — differs from the URL in review_request but is the actual configured value).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: BulkDeleteInput uses Pydantic with List[str] and 400 on empty list — correct input validation.
server.py: bulk-delete-searches also cascades result cleanup via db.results.delete_many({search_id: {$in: ids}}) — consistent with single delete semantics.
ResultCard.tsx: getSourceLabel uses URL parser with graceful fallback and strips 'www.' — robust for any URL shape.
results.tsx & history.tsx: delayLongPress=350 gives responsive multi-select entry; select-all toggles deselect-all when all already selected — good UX.
index.tsx: SearchBottomSheet import removed and no 'Crea Ricerca' string remains anywhere in the home screen — clean removal.
Non-blocking (pre-existing, out of scope): API layer uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback via process.env — fine for Expo web preview.
seed_data_creation: Test data created ephemerally by tests and cleaned up (TEST_ prefixed queries; searches and results deleted at end of each test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL from frontend/.env is https://jarvis-assistant-603.preview.emergentagent.com. Splash animation takes ~5-6s before menu-button appears — use wait_for_selector timeout>=15s. Category page uses testID='search-input' + 'submit-button'. Results screen: 'delete-search-button' (single trash icon), 'cancel-selection-button', 'select-all-button', 'delete-selected-button' bottom bar; each card has result-card-{id}, result-checkbox-{id} (only in selection mode), open-link-{id}. History screen: history-item-{id}, history-checkbox-{id}, delete-search-{id} (per-row trash), same multi-select testIDs as results. AI result generation via /api/search/process typically takes 7-15s.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug found.
